title: CBN Consumer Complaint Lodgment & Escalation Procedure
summary: Mandates that commercial banks must resolve consumer electronic complaints within 14 days. If the bank fails to resolve or issue a satisfactory response, consumers can escalate directly to the Consumer Protection Department (CPD) via cpd@cbn.gov.ng.

title: CBN Guidelines on Electronic Payment Channels & Direct Debits
summary: Directs that instant failed interbank transfers require NIP Session ID tracing, and same-bank failed transfers must be automatically reversed within 24 hours.

title: NCC Consumer Complaints Procedure
statutory_basis: NCC Consumer Code of Practice Regulations 2007
summary: Requires consumers to first lodge their service complaints directly with their telecom service provider and obtain a unique complaint ticket reference.

title: NCC Guidance on Escalating Telecom Complaints (Article 126)
summary: Empowers consumers to escalate unresolved telecom complaints to the NCC via Toll-Free 622 or consumer.ncc.gov.ng if the telecom provider fails to resolve within their published SLA.

title: CBN Framework on Fraud Desk Operations and Precautionary Liens
statutory_basis: CBN Fraud Desk Circular & Cybercrimes Act 2015
summary: Establishes mandatory 24/7 bank fraud desks and interbank communication via the NIBSS portal to place immediate precautionary Post-No-Debit (PND) restrictions on recipient accounts upon reported fraud.

publisher: Nigeria Police Force National Cybercrime Centre (NPF-NCCC)
title: NPF-NCCC Cybercrime e-Reporting and Investigation Protocol
summary: Provides the official law-enforcement channel to report online financial fraud, account hacking, and unauthorized debits, generating the official police extract needed for court-ordered fund repatriation.

publisher: Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Commission (FCCPC)
title: Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Act (FCCPA) 2018 (Sections 114–130)
summary: Guarantees consumers the right to timely performance of service, goods matching description, and full refunds when a supplier fails to deliver, prohibiting deceptive marketing and unfair business practices.

title: Card Scheme & Gateway Chargeback Rules for Merchandise Not Received
statutory_basis: Mastercard/Visa Chargeback Rules (Reason Code: Goods/Services Not Received)
summary: Permits buyers who paid via online checkout or card to lodge chargeback claims and transaction inquiries on dispute lookup portals to place temporary holds on merchant settlement.
